about_the_game:
Once you have downloaded this content, you can set a new master by going to Hidden Leaf Village in the online lobby followed by the Ninjutsu Library.

A special training pack for your avatar!

As you train with Mei Terumi, you will acquire Training Points that can be used to unlock a wide variety of Ninjutsu and costumes for your avatar!

Content includes:
• 2 Ninjutsu
- Water Style: Water Pillar (Heal Type)
- Lava Style: Dissolving Jutsu (Heal Type)

• 1 Secret Technique
- Vapor Style: Solid Fog Jutsu (Heal Type)

• 2 Avatar Parts
- Hair (Mei), for male/female avatars
- Hair (Mizukage Hat), for male/female avatars

• 1 Costume
- Mei Outfit: Top and Bottom, for male/female avatars

• 1 Defense-Type Weapon
- Twinsword: Hiramekarei (Release)

• Additional Content
- Honorary Title: Manhunter
